name: Barbarian audit: Ancestral Spirit spell modifier reaches its target spells (#2542) (rank 2)
contract: Audit report #2542 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation. Two ranks exist (705153 amount 50, 705154 amount 100); this scenario exercises rank 2, the stronger/most-visible amount, per the same rank-selection convention as the existing #963 Gruesome scenario.
